She then looked at the guard and said with a smile, "Although Prince Xin has given orders, you can't just let our Prince make a wasted trip, can you? Furthermore, the Regent is concerned for Prince Xin’s health; hearing he was ill, he came immediately. How can he be at ease without seeing him? When the late Emperor was alive, he valued harmony and deep affection among his sons. The Prince still remembers the teachings of the poetic court and dares not forget them daily."

"I know you are in a difficult position, and I won't ask you to make the decision. Why not go in and announce us? Let Prince Xin decide whether to see us or not."

With things put this way, and even the late Emperor invoked, the guard dared not say more. He wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and nodded, heading into the mansion.

Just as the door opened, an elderly man in a dark blue robe with a white beard stepped out.

It was an imperial physician from the Medical Bureau, whom Xie Yunzhou recognized.

The physician glanced at Xie Yunzhou and hurriedly said, "Regent, greetings! Are you here to visit Prince Xin? Oh, what a pity. The Prince’s illness has worsened; he is currently in a daze and asleep."

Xie Yunzhou frowned and nodded slightly at the physician.

The physician nodded back and left with his medicine chest.

The person seeing the physician out was the steward of the Prince Xin’s Mansion. This old man was far more eloquent than the guards. Seeing them, he hurried out and bowed deeply. "It is the Regent! Please forgive me for not coming out to greet you! Are you here to see the Prince? Oh dear, please, come in quickly! I will have someone serve tea immediately!"

Xie Yunzhou frowned tightly and said briefly, "No need. I will just take a look and leave, so as not to disturb Prince Xin’s recovery."

Hearing his insistence on seeing Xie Yunqi, the steward did not refuse and led them inside, saying as they walked, "You have come at an unfortunate time! If you had come two days earlier, the Prince would have been able to sit up and have tea with you. But today, his illness has worsened. He sleeps morning and night, with very little time spent awake."

Shen Lingjiang, following behind Xie Yunzhou, interjected, "What illness does Prince Xin have?"

The steward didn't recognize Shen Lingjiang, stared at her for a moment, and replied, "Alas, it’s hard to say. The physicians only call it a common cold, but it keeps recurring and never seems to heal. This past month has worried me to death! Two or three physicians from the Medical Bureau have been changed, and none of them can say for sure. We can only nurse him carefully."

He looked genuinely worried, his face full of distress, as if he were truly anxious for his master.

After speaking, he led them into the main courtyard and then into the bedchamber. Before they even entered, they could smell the scent of bitter medicine.

Xie Yunzhou saw Xie Yunqi lying on the bed, his face pale and sickly, much thinner than he had been before the new year, with beads of cold sweat on his forehead.

"Hey! The Prince is sweating, why haven't you wiped it off yet!"

The steward scolded the maid kneeling by the bed, his tone harsh.

The maid immediately wrung out a silk cloth to wipe the Prince’s sweat and busily changed the wet towel on his forehead.

The steward then turned to Xie Yunzhou, looking as if he had more to say. "Your Highness, as you can see..."

Xie Yunzhou took one look, turned, and walked out of the room. He glanced at the steward and said lightly, "Since Prince Xin is so ill, I will not disturb him further. Take good care of him."

The steward bowed hurriedly, "Yes, yes! It is my lack of hospitality this time. Please walk slowly, Your Highness!"

Xie Yunzhou said nothing more and pulled Shen Lingjiang out of the mansion.

After they left the mansion, Xie Yunzhou said, half-doubting, "...Is he really ill?"

Shen Lingjiang: "Prince Xin is in his prime, and with imperial physicians attending to him, how could a minor cold drag on for a month without healing?"

Xie Yunzhou added, "But that Physician Li is the one who usually attends to the Emperor. He is upright and cannot be bought. If he says he is ill, then he must be truly ill."

Shen Lingjiang also said, "A Prince is ill; how could the palace not send physicians? If he were faking an illness, it would be deceiving the Emperor. How could he be so foolish?"

chapters.title: Chaos of the Spring Examinations
chapters.content:
"The illness is real, but the cause is something the physicians cannot explain. I fear only Prince Xin himself knows the truth."

Once Shen Lingjiang said this, Xie Yunzhou thought for a moment and understood. He said with slight surprise, "You mean he made himself ill just to stay in the capital?"

Shen Lingjiang did not answer directly, only replying, "It is merely a guess. Perhaps Prince Xin is just that unlucky and happened to fall ill for a month?"

Xie Yunzhou curled his lip, muttering with annoyance, "At his age, he really dares to put himself through such trouble."

Shen Lingjiang couldn't help but shake her head, sighing, "If I recall correctly, Prince Xin is only forty, right?"

Forty is the age of no confusion; how could that be considered "at his age"?

Xie Yunzhou scoffed, "He is more than a full cycle older than me. Isn't that 'at his age'?"

Hearing his fallacious logic, Shen Lingjiang helplessly said nothing more.

Xie Yunzhou, however, seemed to be in a good mood. He raised an eyebrow at Shen Lingjiang and said, "I'm in a good mood today. I'll treat you to a meal at Tianxiaju."

Shen Lingjiang nodded slightly and smiled, "I would be honored."

The two walked side by side toward Tianxiaju.

Tianxiaju was the largest restaurant in Yandu. Located in a bustling area, no one knew who the owner was, only that they were quite powerful, and even royalty and nobles would not easily cause trouble there.

The two entered the main gate of Tianxiaju. Before long, a waiter dressed in gray came out to greet them with a very pleasant smile.

"Would the two of you like a table in the main hall or a private room? Have you reserved a spot?"

Xie Yunzhou walked in front, glanced at the crowded main hall, and said calmly, "Heaven Room Number One."

The waiter grinned and shouted, "Heaven Room Number One for two! Please, this way!"

The waiter led them upstairs. Tianxiaju had three floors, and the best and most expensive private rooms were on the top floor, overlooking the Imperial River. If one dined at night, they could enjoy the shimmering, lantern-lit night view.

Shen Lingjiang followed behind, tilting her head to look at the young scholars drinking and making merry at the tables in the hall below. They were all wearing the same green robes andConfucian caps or large hats; by their attire, they were students from the Imperial Academy.

Shen Lingjiang looked several times before turning the corner to enter the first private room on the third floor.

The waiter invited them to sit and presented a menu, saying with a smile, "Take your time, and tell me what you would like to eat or drink!"

The task of ordering was left to Xie Yunzhou, the host. Shen Lingjiang didn't even look at the menu, instead turning her head to survey the room.

The decor was antique, with tables and chairs made of fine pear wood. In the middle stood a silk screen as tall as a person, painted with landscapes, through which the furnishings on the other side were faintly visible.

Leaning against the wall was a five-tiered curio shelf holding odd little trinkets. Near the window was a zither stand and stool, with a paulownia wood zither placed on top. In a bronze incense burner on a high stand, smoke curled slowly.

It looked very opulent; a meal here must cost a fortune.

"That will be all. Bring it quickly; we are quite hungry."

Shen Lingjiang turned back and saw that Xie Yunzhou had already ordered and handed the menu to the young waiter.

This man was used to being in charge and had long held a high position. Even though he was the host, he hadn't even shown the menu to Shen Lingjiang, ordering everything himself.

Accustomed to being pampered, how could he remember to care for others?

Shen Lingjiang shook her head helplessly and walked over, asking, "What did you order?"

Xie Yunzhou looked at her and said with some awkwardness, "Yuliang cakes and sticky rice cakes, both are sweet, so you won't hold a grudge against me for making you drop that piece of chestnut cake every day."

Hearing him say this, Shen Lingjiang was stunned.

Before she could speak, the waiter laughed from the side, "Our sticky rice cakes might sound ordinary, but they taste divine! If you like sweets, you will definitely love this dish! Please wait a moment, the food will be up soon!"

Xie Yunzhou nodded and added, "And bring a pot of Golden Sparrow Tongue tea."

The waiter was overjoyed: "Right away!"

The waiter left with the menu.

Shen Lingjiang shook her head and sighed, "The Prince is truly generous."

Xie Yunzhou looked out the window and replied with annoyance, "Just eat if you're told to eat. Why so much chatter!"

Shen Lingjiang chuckled, then suddenly remembered something and asked, "The Spring Examinations are coming up soon, aren't they?"

Xie Yunzhou: "Mid-second month."

Shen Lingjiang nodded and continued, "The Lantern Festival has passed; there is less than a month left until the Spring Examinations."

Xie Yunzhou finally withdrew his gaze to look at her, frowning as he asked, "Why? Why are you suddenly concerned about the Spring Examinations? What, does the Seventh Prince want to take the top scholar exam in my Great Liang?"

Shen Lingjiang looked at him in silence for a while, thinking that this man truly could not say anything pleasant.

But after a moment of silence, she continued, "The exams are imminent, but I noticed the students downstairs are not in a hurry to study. Instead, they are drinking and composing poetry quite happily. I just saw them playing the 'Flying Flower' game."

Hearing this, Xie Yunzhou stopped his teasing and pondered for a moment before saying, "Perhaps they are not this year's candidates."

Even as he said it, Xie Yunzhou himself didn't believe it.

In previous years, you wouldn't see candidates in tea houses or restaurants at this time; they would mostly be studying at home or in academies.

There were younger ones who couldn't take the metropolitan exam yet, but they would be infected by the tense atmosphere and study even harder than usual, not going out to drink and make merry.

Yet, more than half of the hall downstairs were students from the Imperial Academy.

Unable to figure it out and having no explanation, Xie Yunzhou frowned and pondered for a while before simply changing the subject.

"Do you have any good ideas regarding Xie Yunqi?"

At this moment, the waiter entered with tea and snacks.

Shen Lingjiang was not in a hurry to answer. She slowly poured herself a cup of tea, held it, and took a slow sip. Then, she picked up her chopsticks and picked up a piece of white, soft rice cake coated in brown sugar, savoring it carefully. Xie Yunzhou was so irritated by her leisurely manner that he glared at her.

After drinking two cups of tea, Shen Lingjiang finally spoke: "This Golden Sparrow Tongue is indeed good tea, and the snacks are just as the waiter said, crispy, sweet, and sticky."

Xie Yunzhou gritted his teeth: "...Talk about the main issue!"

Shen Lingjiang said, "This food is the most important issue."

Xie Yunzhou: "..."

Xie Yunzhou simply stopped talking and stared at her with a straight face.

Seeing him like this, Shen Lingjiang had no choice but to say, "Poor Lingjiang is confined to the courtyard every day, only able to see the square sky, completely in the dark. I can't think of any good solutions."

She was, after all, a hostage princess sent by an enemy state. Although she hadn't been sent to the hostage residence, she hadn't been free to come and go while staying at Xie Yunzhou’s mansion these past few days.

Hearing her say this, how could Xie Yunzhou not understand? He replied with forced patience, "Your legs are on your own body; do you think I could keep you locked up?"
